title: Tom's Free Time
text:
Tom likes his free time. On Saturday, he plays football with his friends in the park. They play for two hours. After that, Tom goes home and reads a book.

On Sunday, Tom stays at home. He paints pictures in his room. His sister Ana likes to paint too. They often listen to music together in the afternoon.

paragraph_translations: A Tom le gusta su tiempo libre. El sábado, juega al fútbol con sus amigos en el parque. Juegan durante dos horas. Después, Tom vuelve a casa y lee un libro.
El domingo, Tom se queda en casa. Pinta cuadros en su habitación. A su hermana Ana también le gusta pintar. Por la tarde, a menudo escuchan música juntos.
